name: Hachijou Kei
source: A young man who works for a major beverage making company. He does not like deep relationships nor troubles in general, so he spends most of his time looking around for girls and having sex with them with the help of the "Diafre" app. Though he's blunt most of the time, he can never ignore a person in need of help.
